system.description:
A Severed creature has part of their body severely wounded. When a creature gains this condition, roll 1d6 and apply the effect based on the result. If a creature would be Severed again, they instead gain +1 rank of Shaken. Creatures without the listed anatomy are immune to that result. If a creature regains hit points, would cleanse a condition or spends an Action to make a DC 15 Medicine check, this condition ends. You may increase the DC by +2 for every rank of Shaken a creature has.

Hand/Arm. The affected creature cannot make HS or wield a weapon.

Eyes. The affected creature becomes Blinded.

Back/Wings/Tail. The Affected creature loses its flying or swim speed if any. They also lose concentration of all jutsu they are concentrating on and cannot concentrate on more than 1 jutsu at a time.

Foot/Leg. The affected creature cannot cast jutsu with a Mobility (M) component, and their speed is reduced by half.

Torso/Abdomen. The affected creature reduces the damage they deal by 10.

Neck/Head. The affected creature is Staggered, and remains Staggered for this conditions duration.
system.summary: Severed: roll 1d6 for the wound (arm, eyes, back, leg, torso, head); being Severed again adds Shaken instead; DC 15 Medicine to end.

rules.text: 1 Hand/Arm: no hand seals or weapons. 2 Eyes: Blinded. 3 Back/Wings/Tail: loses fly and swim speeds, drops concentration and can concentrate on 1 jutsu. 4 Foot/Leg: no Mobility (M) jutsu, half speed. 5 Torso/Abdomen: −10 damage dealt. 6 Neck/Head: Staggered for the duration. Creatures without that anatomy are immune to that result. Severed again: +1 Shaken instead. Ends if it regains hit points or a condition is cleansed; the Medicine DC rises by 2 per rank of Shaken.
